column1: #mapping_set_description: Manually curated subject-side mappings from FIX Orchestra LinkML entities to FIX Simple Binary Encoding (SBE) LinkML entities. Inverse of fix-sbe-to-fix-orchestra.sssom.tsv: subjects and objects are swapped and broadMatch / narrowMatch predicates are flipped to preserve SKOS semantics. exactMatch, closeMatch, and relatedMatch are symmetric and unchanged. Each Orchestra metamodel class / enum is mapped to its closest SBE counterpart (V1 and V2 listed independently where they exist). Mappings cover only entities with a defensible semantic correspondence and intentionally omit Orchestra-only entities (workflow, scenarios, sessions, actors, ...) for which no SBE counterpart exists.

Same as v1.0.
SBE SetType is a bitset of named choices; closest Orchestra analog is a multi-value CodeSetType.
Same as v1.0.
A single Orchestra CodeType within a CodeSetType corresponds to a single named Choice within an SBE SetType (bitset).
An Orchestra CodeType is equivalent to a single permissible (valid) value within an SBE EnumType.

Orchestra ComponentType groups field / group references in a reusable block; SBE BlockType groups a fixed-layout set of named fields. Structural intent matches at the design-time vs encoding-time boundary.
Same as the v1.0 mapping; v2.0 BlockType additionally exposes offset / primitive-type mixin attributes but the core concept is unchanged.
Orchestra models repeating groups as Components carrying group semantics (no top-level GroupType class); SBE GroupType is a repeating block of fields.
Same as v1.0.
Structured Orchestra Datatype with mapped sub-datatypes corresponds to an SBE composite encoding (a sequence of member encodings).
Same as v1.0; v2.0 differs by holding MemberDataType / RefType children rather than inline simpleType / enumType definitions.
Orchestra Datatype definition is the counterpart of SBE v1.0 EncodedDataType (single-encoding datatype declaration).
SBE v2.0 single-encoding datatype declaration; SBE successor to v1.0 EncodedDataType.
SBE v2.0 MemberDataType is a sub-element of a CompositeDataType; semantically narrower than a top-level Orchestra Datatype definition (inverse of the SBE -> Orchestra narrowMatch).

Orchestra Datatype is defined in terms of mapped primitives; SBE PrimitiveType enumerates encoding-level primitives (uint8, int16, double, ...) and is therefore broader (inverse of the SBE -> Orchestra broadMatch).
Same as v1.0.

Orchestra exposes added / updated / deprecated version-tracking metadata through EntityAttribGrp; SBE exposes the same through VersionAttributes.
Reference-by-name semantics: Orchestra FieldRefType references a previously-defined field; SBE RefType references a previously-defined type / field.
